title: Design: the delete question and taken-name error as the design words them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, named for example Wheel Seals.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category B's row.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click the title.
  7. Type category A's name.
  8. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • Category B's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The menu lists Audit Log and Delete.

Step 4:

  • The dialog reads "Its parts and lines, invoiced ones included, move to Uncategorized, and its QuickBooks mapping is removed. This can't be undone.", with no sentence about invoices already sent.

Step 5:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 6:

  • The title becomes an outlined box.

Step 7:

  • The typed name shows.

Step 8:

  • The red error reads "A category called", the typed name, "already exists. Click away to keep" and category B's name, with a period.
